subject.title: fix: avoid gateway daemon repair on protocol mismatch

question: Should the protocol-mismatch daemon-repair skip land as a repaired narrow PR, or be folded into the broader Windows gateway migration PR?
rationale: Both open PRs touch compatibility-sensitive gateway doctor repair behavior, and this branch is currently dirty with blockers that require an owner decision before merge.

options.title: Rebase And Keep Separate
options.body: Repair this PR by preserving authenticated health and deep diagnostics, then review it as the narrow protocol-mismatch slice.

options.title: Fold Into Windows Migration
options.body: Move the useful protocol-mismatch behavior into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88311 and close this PR only after that replacement becomes landable or merged.

options.title: Pause Until Broader PR Settles
options.body: Leave this PR open but inactive until the broader migration branch is rebased enough to show whether the narrow slice is still needed.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Keep Separate
recommendation.body: Repair this PR by preserving authenticated health and deep diagnostics, then review it as the narrow protocol-mismatch slice.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the active broader Windows gateway migration PR and recent main history for the current doctor health contract.
